description: a wiry young woman with short black hair in a black cloak of layered raven feathers, a black raven-beak half mask over the upper face, a dark fitted leather jerkin, dark trousers and soft dark boots, both gloved hands empty and relaxed, the arms hanging naturally at the sides, the fingers loose, no daggers and nothing in the hands, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes and colours; the hands empty, without the daggers
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
